name: salesforce-crm
description: Connect your Salesforce CRM to Claude. Search, create, and manage leads, contacts, accounts, and opportunities. Log activities, run SOQL queries, and more — all without leaving Claude.
author: Emizentech

setup.instructions: Install PHP 8.0+ with cURL extension, then configure your Salesforce credentials as environment variables (SF_USERNAME, SF_PASSWORD, SF_SECURITY_TOKEN or SF_CLIENT_ID, SF_CLIENT_SECRET). No server deployment needed — the plugin runs locally.
requirements: Salesforce org (Production, Sandbox, or Developer Edition)
Salesforce credentials (Username/Password/Token OR OAuth Connected App)
